android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.request: Usage access settings, explained in setup; required only for monitoring
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.denied: Monitoring cannot start; settings, cats and test breaks remain available

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.feature: Optional background break activity presentation exemption
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.denied: Tap notification to open the break; no automatic display guarantee

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.request: Normal permission; enabled by user action
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.denied: Start failure shown; user can retry

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.feature: Monitoring not described by standard FGS types; manifest subtype explanation
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.request: Normal permission; Play declaration/review required before release

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.request: Optional contextual runtime prompt in setup; settings repair
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.denied: No notification reminder; FGS task-manager notice still follows Android behavior

com.android.vending.BILLING.request: Normal manifest permission, no runtime prompt
com.android.vending.BILLING.denied: Paid purchase unavailable, free features available

android.permission.INTERNET.feature: Retained Google Billing transport networking, visible in merger report; no app backend
android.permission.INTERNET.denied: Billing unavailable; bounded cached access only

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.feature: Library connectivity observation for retained Billing transport; local cat media needs no network

${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EX.feature: Signature protection for private dynamically registered receivers
${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EX.denied: Other apps cannot send to protected receivers
